teaser.en: A dry-country cordia shrub, a cousin of the sandpaper saucer-berry.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha cordia cha nchi kavu, binamu wa sandpaper saucer-berry.

summary.en: *Chitundo* is a shrub of the borage family that grows in the dry bush of north-east Africa and Kenya. Pakia records only its name and how it is identified.
summary.sw: *Chitundo* ni kichaka cha familia ya borage (Boraginaceae) kinachoota katika vichaka vikavu vya kaskazini-mashariki mwa Afrika na Kenya. Pakia ameandika jina lake tu na jinsi kinavyotambuliwa.

about.en: *Cordia somaliensis* is a shrub with simple, roughish leaves. Like its relatives it has small whitish flowers and small, fleshy, often sticky fruits sitting in a cup-like calyx. Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Cordia somaliensis* ni kichaka chenye majani sahili yanayokwaruza kiasi. Kama jamaa zake, kina maua madogo meupe-meupe na matunda madogo yenye nyama, ambayo mara nyingi yanata, yaliyokaa ndani ya kikombe cha sepali. Wadigo hukitambua kwa majani yake.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland in Somalia, Ethiopia and Kenya.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vikavu nchini Somalia, Ethiopia na Kenya.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *chitundo* and lists it among the names that cannot be analysed. No Swahili or English name has been recorded.
names.sw: Pakia ameandika jina la Kidigo *chitundo* na analiorodhesha miongoni mwa majina yasiyoweza kuchambuliwa. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.
